verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The evidence only mentions Klaviyo-maintained SDKs and reference code in a Klaviyo Labs GitHub. Neither is the product's own source, and no open license is documented, so this is adjacent material rather than support for the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
